The AI is a clerk, not a judge

It has one narrow job: take the free-form notes a facilitator writes while watching an activity and turn them into tidy observations, each tied to a specific skill and a specific piece of evidence. It does not decide a score on its own. It does not invent evidence. Nothing reaches a participant or their organization until a person has read it.
